title: User Retention Cohort
desc: Track monthly active users by signup cohort using alias reuse
query:
-- Cohort analysis: track users over time since they signed up
-- No special syntax needed - just computed columns + group by

from events
  join users                            -- Join to get signup_date
  
  -- Group by cohort (signup month) and period (months since signup)
  -- Alias reuse lets us reference 'cohort' immediately after defining it
  group by 
    month(users.signup_date) as cohort,
    months_between(events.event_date, users.signup_date) as period
  (
    count(distinct user_id) as active   -- Active users in this cohort+period
  )
  
  order by cohort, period

title: Revenue Cohort with LTV
desc: Track revenue and calculate lifetime value by first purchase cohort
query:
-- Revenue cohort with cumulative LTV calculation

from orders
  join customers
  
  group by 
    month(customers.first_order_date) as cohort,
    months_between(orders.order_date, customers.first_order_date) as period
  (
    sum(total) as revenue,
    count(distinct customer_id) as customers
  )
  
  -- Add cohort size and cumulative metrics
  select *,
    first(customers) over cohort as cohort_size,       -- Period 0 customers = cohort size
    running_sum(revenue) over cohort as cumulative_rev,
    cumulative_rev / cohort_size as ltv                -- Lifetime value per customer
    
  order by cohort, period

title: Retention with Percentages
desc: Calculate retention percentage for each cohort period
query:
-- Full retention analysis with percentages

from events
  join users
  
  group by 
    month(users.signup_date) as cohort,
    months_between(events.event_date, users.signup_date) as period
  (
    count(distinct user_id) as active
  )
  
  -- Calculate retention metrics
  select 
    cohort,
    period,
    active,
    first(active) over cohort as cohort_size,  -- Size is period 0 active count
    round(active::numeric / cohort_size * 100, 1) as retention_pct
    
  where period between 0 and 12  -- First year only
  order by cohort, period

title: Segmented Cohorts
query:
-- Cohort analysis segmented by acquisition channel
-- Compare how different channels retain users

from events
  join users
  
  group by 
    users.channel,                                     -- Segment dimension
    month(users.signup_date) as cohort,
    months_between(events.event_date, users.signup_date) as period
  (
    count(distinct user_id) as active
  )
  
  select *,
    first(active) over (channel, cohort) as cohort_size,
    round(active::numeric / cohort_size * 100, 1) as retention_pct
    
  order by channel, cohort, period
